purpose: Research request "How the base game records main-story progress" (area A of the P2 game-substrate plan). Quest, quest-phase and scene resources of the main story, serialised to JSON, for fact, journal and phase analysis. Derived from game files: private, ignored by git, never packaged.

tool.name: WolvenKit CLI
tool.whyThisVersion: The version end users get (docs/toolchain.md) and the one the quest knowledge page already used; reads game 2.31 resources.

commands: WolvenKit.CLI extract PATH_TO_GAME/archive/pc/ep1/ep1_2_gamedata.archive -o SCRATCH/raw -r "[.]quest$"   (then pruned to the files below)
WolvenKit.CLI convert serialize SCRATCH/raw   (default settings; one .json written beside each resource, then collected into json/ with the same relative paths)

Scenes (examined, not kept): WolvenKit.CLI extract <both archives> -o SCRATCH/scenes -r "quest.main_quests.*[.]scene$"; versions/, test/ and tests/ folders removed; the scenes that mention a story-state fact were serialised with convert serialize in batches.
run: Every WolvenKit call ran under tools/memory_guard.py --limit 4 (peak about 1.4 GB).

excluded: side quests, minor quests, gigs, open-world activities (areas B and H)
Phantom Liberty open-world content, loading-screen quests, test and gym quests
scenes, journal files and localisation (scenes were only examined, see scenesExamined)
scope.notes: The JSON header of each file records the scratch path it was converted from; those paths are not meaningful.
